news.title: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1
news.summary: Release: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 When I switched LLM over to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 I forget that this would break any plugins which used httpx without directly depending on it. llm-tools-datasette was one of those plugins, now fixed. Tags: datasette , llm
news.summary_zh: Simon Willison 发布了 llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1，修复了 LLM 0.33 改用 httpx2 后导致该插件失效的问题；此前该插件使用 httpx 但未直接依赖它。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 说明底层 HTTP 库的变更可能影响依赖它的 LLM 插件，需要及时适配。
news.summary_en: Simon Willison released llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1, fixing breakage after LLM 0.33 switched to httpx2; the plugin had used httpx without directly depending on it.
news.why_it_matters_en: It shows how changes to underlying HTTP libraries can break dependent LLM plugins and require updates.

news.title: llm-echo 0.5
news.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reason
news.summary_zh: llm-echo 0.5 发布，这个调试插件提供一个不调用真实 LLM、只回显提示词的“模型”；新版本更新了模拟 token 用量统计，以计入工具调用、系统提示和推理等内容。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 帮助开发者在无需真实模型的情况下调试 LLM 工具链和 token 统计。
news.summary_en: llm-echo 0.5 is a debug plugin that provides a 'model' which does not involve an LLM and simply repeats back prompts; the release updates simulated token usage counts for tool calls, system prompts, and reasoning.
news.why_it_matters_en: It helps developers debug LLM tooling and token accounting without using a real model.

top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：角色IP与生成式AI结合可能加速；风险：平台稳定性、创作者条款和内容治理可能变化。

top5.title_en: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says

top5.why_zh: 开发者平台的默认模型选择会直接影响构建成本、能力上限和迁移决策，也反映模型厂商的竞争态势。
top5.why_en: A developer platform’s default model choice directly affects build costs, capability ceilings and migration decisions, and reflects model-vendor competition.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 默认模型切换是商业决策，不必然代表技术优劣；关键要看定价、稳定性和开发者反馈。
top5.editor_judgment_en: The default switch is a business decision, not necessarily a verdict on technical quality; pricing, reliability and developer feedback matter most.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：OpenAI生态工具与潜在成本优势；风险：平台锁定和后续迁移成本。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: OpenAI ecosystem tooling and potential cost advantages; risk: platform lock-in and later migration costs.
top5.action_zh: 若使用Replit，检查默认模型、定价和回退选项，并阅读来源。
top5.action_en: If you use Replit, check the default model, pricing and fallback options, and read the source.
top5.original_title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says

top5.action_zh: 审计公共代码库、应用配置和云角色权限，轮换暴露凭证。
top5.action_en: Audit public repos, app configurations and cloud-role permissions, and rotate exposed credentials.

top5.why_zh: 平台条款与AI训练数据边界会影响创作者、网站主和AI公司，声明与实际行为需分开观察。

editorial.core_zh: 今日AI新闻的核心不是新模型发布，而是人才与平台重组、模型厂商竞争，以及AI代理暴露出的凭证与权限风险。
editorial.core_en: Today’s AI news is less about new models and more about talent and platform reshuffling, model-vendor competition, and credential/permission risks exposed by AI agents.
editorial.trend_zh: 大型媒体公司加速吸纳AI人才；开发者平台的默认模型成为竞争杠杆；代理安全从理论风险变成可复现的配置与权限问题。
editorial.trend_en: Major media companies are accelerating AI talent absorption; default models on developer platforms are becoming competitive levers; agent security is moving from theoretical risk to reproducible configuration and permission failures.

editorial.next_question_en: Will the Disney deal attract a higher bid, and how will terms change for Character.AI creators?
